 You can snag the new HONOR Play 20A for just P45 a day on Shopee this 11.11
 Get a 6,000mAh battery and a smart rear screen for just P45 a day! 📱 The new HONOR Play 20A drops on Shopee this 11.11 with 0% SPayLater plans and extra vouchers. Here's everything you need to know 👇 #HONORPhilippines #Shopee1111
 by 
 ASTIG PR 
 5 hours ago 5 hours ago 
 Advertisements 
 MANILA, Philippines (Nov. 2026) – Upgrading to a feature-packed smartphone without draining your wallet is getting much easier for Pinoy shoppers this mega sale season, as the HONOR Play 20A drops exclusively on Shopee for as low as PHP 45 (approx. $0.77) a day.
 Ahead of its official nationwide release on Nov. 28, 2026, early birds can purchase the device during the 11.11 Mega Pamasko Sale for a discounted price of PHP 8,099 (approx. $139), down from its standard PHP 8,999 (approx. $155) retail price. Shoppers looking for flexible payment options can take advantage of 0% interest installment plans for six months via SPayLater.
 Big screen, long battery life, and a rear display
 Built for everyday entertainment and convenience, the budget phone packs a 6.9-inch display with a 90Hz refresh rate alongside a massive 6,000mAh battery designed to last through long hours of use.
 What sets it apart is an interactive 2-inch Smart Rear Screen. This mini display allows users to check incoming notifications, control music playback, and snap high-quality selfies using the main rear camera.
 Stephen Cheng, vice president of HONOR Philippines, explained that bringing the device to Shopee early aims to give Pinoy consumers more affordable ways to access modern mobile technology with flexible payment terms.
 Exclusive Shopee 11.11 vouchers and livestreams
 During the 11.11 promo, buyers can claim an extra 20% discount voucher and free shipping vouchers on Shopee.
 Special Shopee Live sessions will also offer extra discounts, vouchers, and freebies ahead of the sale date. Tune in on Nov. 10 at 12 p.m. for a livestream hosted by James Afante, followed by a 6 p.m. session featuring Kris Aquino and Bimby Aquino.
 Official launch details
 The early online access window opens on Nov. 11, 2026, exclusively on Shopee, prior to the phone’s official nationwide store release on Nov. 28, 2026.
